component.basis: Phase 4 component catalog C1-C9 (specification 2.1.0 section 16); a component counts when a recorded qualifying assertion executes, even if it fails; skipped paths earn nothing. This is an HTTP-only run: C9 review UI needs retained browser/manual evidence and is never counted here, so covered is at most 8.

system.basis: Exercised-criterion coverage of AC-01 to AC-11 (denominator 11): an AC counts when at least one mapped qualifying assertion executed, even if it failed. This is not acceptance success. AC-09 HTTP checks are only the automated preservation portion; Microsoft Excel no-repair inspection remains a separate human release gate.
